chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “There is no surety in a hadd punishment.”

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in the chain of transmission
key_terms.حَدٍّ: a prescribed legal punishment established in the Sacred Law
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as the source of this ruling
key_terms.كَفَالَةَ: surety, guarantee, or legal undertaking on behalf of another

ai.seo_question: Is surety or guarantee accepted in cases involving hadd punishments in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal ruling from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning hadd punishments. It indicates that legal surety or guarantee is not accepted in matters involving a hadd, underscoring the distinct legal treatment of prescribed punishments.
